steps.name: three players come online, each with their own private name and no Credits
the first Credits come from selling cards to the system, which says what it is
a fixed price sale: list, find it, buy it, the fee is taken once and both sides see it
an auction: a bid, an outbid, the banner, then it closes on the server clock with nobody touching it
a swap: an offer, a counteroffer from the seller, acceptance, both card sets move at once
a standing buy order reserves Credits and fills at the listing's price when the card appears
listing from the composer: choose the exact card, see the price and fee, confirm, and it is live and escrowed
the realm reconciles: cards in one place, Credits conserved, nothing left reserved
the same trading works at phone width and in saved monochrome
no page errors; every request went to the one allowed origin
